## About
Arbutus Auto Body is a body shop at 4621 Leeds Ave in Baltimore, serving the city and the surrounding areas. We specialize in auto body repair, collision repair and custom painting, and we bring old-fashioned quality together with modern equipment.
We know body work is not fun or convenient, so we try to make the process as easy as we can. You might not be related to us, but we want you to feel like family. One reviewer wrote that after a break-in, we helped her daughter and made her feel safe before sending her on her way.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating across 93 Google reviews. Stop by for an estimate and see how we work.

## Services
- Collision repair: Professional auto body and collision repair for all makes and models of foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Custom painting: Custom paint work done with care. One reviewer said her car looked like it just came off the showroom.
- Touch up paint: Touch up paint for chips and smaller spots.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent removal without repainting the panel.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No appointment needed. Just bring your car in.

Q: My car can't be driven. Can you help with a tow?
A: Yes, towing is available. You can call Ridgeway Towing at 410-747-8697.

Q: Can I get a rental car while mine is in the shop?
A: Yes, we have rental cars onsite.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes, a night drop is available.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We are open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
